## At work

I'm the lead software engineer on GQMLab, the laboratory information management system behind a UKAS-accredited geotechnical laboratory: a Python/Flask REST API, MySQL, a Flutter front end, Docker and Linux.

It includes Gio, an AI assistant with tool-use over the live system: SQL, charts and report-schema introspection behind a read-only database user, validated queries and role-gated access. An accredited lab is an unusually unforgiving place to put an LLM: every answer has to be reproducible and every query auditable.

## Open-source work (own time)

### Quantum Relational Language (QRL)

A quantum programming language where entanglement is a first-class citizen: relations-first, compiling to measurement-based quantum computing. Type system where `Switch(d)` programs are provably causally nonseparable; 968 passing tests; ~15.1k lines across 31 modules; four backends (Perceval, PennyLane, graphix, Qiskit).

Hardware-validated on a Quandela photonic QPU: S = 2.61 ± 0.08.

- [GitHub](https://github.com/entangledcode/qrl)
- [Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.18292199)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18292199)

Most of the writing on this site is QRL research.

### Bell

An assistant for QRL: plain English in, real QRL code executed in a sandbox, real numbers out. Hosted API or a self-hosted Qwen3-8B + LoRA fine-tune (815 instruction pairs). [bell.entangledcode.dev](https://bell.entangledcode.dev)

### Froe

A local-first coding agent in Go: a single static binary with an agent loop, file and shell tools, adapters for local model runtimes (llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM) plus Mistral (EU-hosted) as a cloud fallback, and a Neovim client. I use it to build QRL and Bell. [GitHub](https://github.com/dcoldeira/froe)
